body_md:
In the 18th century Britain became a world power. **Sir Robert Walpole** was the first Prime Minister. Bonnie Prince Charlie was defeated at **Culloden** in 1746.

The **Industrial Revolution** changed how people lived and worked. James Watt improved steam power and Isambard Kingdom Brunel built railways and bridges.

The slave trade was made illegal in **1807** and slavery ended in the British Empire in **1833**. Nelson won at Trafalgar in 1805 and Wellington at Waterloo in 1815. **Queen Victoria** reigned for almost 64 years. Women won the vote in 1918 (over 30) and 1928 (at 21).
key_facts: 1721: Walpole becomes the first Prime Minister
